entities.summary: Abdal Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Husayn Birjandi, a 16th-century Persian astronomer, mathematician, and physicist, was born in Birjand, Iran, and died in 1528. He made significant contributions to the fields of astronomy and mathematics, including the development of new astronomical instruments and the calculation of the solar year. Birjandi's work had a lasting impact on the development of Islamic science and its transmission to Europe during the Renaissance. He is considered one of the most important Persian scholars of his time, and his legacy continues to be studied by scholars today. Birjandi's work in mathematics also led to the development of new mathematical techniques and the calculation of pi to unprecedented levels of accuracy. His contributions to astronomy and mathematics have had a lasting impact on the development of modern science and continue to be celebrated today.
